name: Non-rigid NeRF (NR-NeRF)
definition: A method modeling time-varying scene appearance using a per-scene canonical volume, per-scene rigidity flag (MLP), and per-frame ray bending operator (MLP).
summary: Non-rigid NeRF models dynamic scenes by decomposing them into a static canonical volume and a learned deformation field, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling rigidity to prevent unwanted deformation in static regions.
